statements.quote: Net cash flows from investing activities and their variability across each period related primarily to capital expenditures, which were $11.34 billion and $8.90 billion for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively, mainly for AI-related capital expenditures, global factory expansion and machinery and equipment as we expand and enhance our product roadmap.
statements.notes: Total 2024 capex. AI-related capex is named first among the drivers ('mainly for'), but the AI part is not quantified. The 2023 figure ($8.90 billion) is a prior year and is not recorded.

statements.quote: Owing and subject to the foregoing as well as the pipeline of announced projects under development, all other continuing infrastructure growth and varying levels of inflation, we currently expect our capital expenditures to exceed $11.00 billion in 2025 and in each of the following two fiscal years.
statements.notes: 'Exceed $11.00 billion' is a floor, so the amount is a lower bound, not a point estimate. The same outlook covers 'each of the following two fiscal years' (2026–2027); those years are not recorded separately. The AI link ('investing in autonomy and other artificial intelligence enabled training and products') is in the preceding sentence, which this sentence refers to as 'the foregoing'; the quoted sentence itself does not mention AI.

statements.quote: The overall increases were primarily driven by additional costs year over year related to AI programs.
statements.notes: Refers to the $571 million (14%) increase in R&D expenses in 2024, stated in the preceding sentence. The AI part of that increase is not quantified. The sentence names no year, so code should apply the filing's reported year (2024).
